subject: Request: Exec approval — Magellan Analytics special terms (data residency & audit scope)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Exec approval — Magellan Analytics special terms (data residency & audit scope)

Team,

Quick summary: Magellan Analytics (large EU-based customer) is ready to sign but Legal flagged three non-standard asks for our Private/VPC offering:

- Explicit EU-only data residency clause (they want a clause guaranteeing data will not leave EU controls)
- Expanded audit rights: ability to conduct an annual on-site audit (their CISO requests up to 2/year during the first 12 months) and allowance for a third-party auditor
- Deployment constraint: they want a dedicated on-prem gateway in their colo for cross-network traffic + 6-node reserved capacity commitment

Commercial ask: 22% first-year discount to land the ACV (up from our standard 15% for this tier).

Why this is urgent: they want contract text and a redlined SOW by EOD 21 Apr to make procurement and fiscal close before end-of-quarter. If we stall, they're likely to push to a competitor who will accept broader audit language.

Attachments: Redwood_Service_SLA_v2.pdf (current SLA), Proposed_SOW_Magellan_2026.pdf (customer SOW), Magellan_Audit_Request_Form.docx (their audit checklist).

Requesting:
1) Exec approval to offer up to 22% discount and the 6-node committed capacity as a one-time exception if Legal and Security accept restricted audit language.
2) Direction on the audit ask: do we accept one on-site + remote evidence from third-party, or is any on-site audit a hard no?
3) Any additional commercial guardrails (time-limited concession, audit notice windows, approved auditor list) we must require.

If I don't hear back, Deal Desk will propose a fallback: 20% discount + remote-only audits + explicit redaction limits. Need final guidance by COB 21 Apr.

Thanks — Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

[Attachment: Redwood_Service_SLA_v2.pdf] [Attachment: Proposed_SOW_Magellan_2026.pdf] [Attachment: Magellan_Audit_Request_Form.docx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exec approval — Magellan Analytics special terms (data residency & audit scope)

+1 on urgency. A few legal notes after a quick pass:

- Discount: I can sign off on up to 20% as an exec-level one-off; 22% needs CFO approval. Recommend we offer 20% and a one-time onboarding credit instead of deeper list-price cut.

- Audit language: we should not accept an unlimited on-site audit right or unrestricted third-party auditors. Proposed compromise:
  * Allow one annual on-site audit for the first 12 months,
  * Require 45 days' advance notice,
  * Scope limited to systems supporting customer data (not company-wide internal systems),
  * Redwood has right to redact any information that contains third-party customer PII or proprietary kernels; redaction to be subject to SOC 2 / ISO-27001 evidence.
  * Third-party auditors allowed only from our pre-approved list and must sign an NDA.

- Data residency: we can commit to EU logical residency for customer data in the control plane and logs, but cannot guarantee that operational metadata will never transit non-EU control planes during exceptional maintenance without explicit carve-outs. We need a short clause describing maintainable exceptions (emergencies with 7-day notice).

- Deployment constraints: dedicated on-prem gateway is okay if the SOW defines ownership (customer-managed) and we do not accept liability for colo hardware. Include insurance and indemnity language.

I recommend we proceed with: 20% discount (year 1) + limited audit language above + committed 6-node capacity. Laura: please confirm if that is acceptable to you for exec approve; otherwise I'll loop CFO.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Deal Desk (Legal Ops), Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exec approval — Magellan Analytics special terms (data residency & audit scope)

Team,

I approve the compromise Karthik proposed with these explicit guardrails:

- Commercial concession: 20% discount for year 1 only (must be documented as a one-time concession in the amendment)
- Audit: one on-site audit per 12-month period during the first year; 45 days' notice; limited scope to systems processing the customer
- Third-party auditors: permitted but must be on our approved list and sign Redwood NDA; any redaction disputes escalate to Legal for binding review
- Data residency: commit to EU logical residency and encrypt keys with customer KMS for EU keys; we will include a maintenance exception with required notification
- Deployment: customer-owned colo hardware is acceptable; Redwood liability limited per SOW; need COI and KMS details before go-live

Please put the amended SOW and a short addendum together. I will sign off on these limited exceptions. Anything beyond the above (higher discount or additional audit frequency) needs COO/CFO sign-off.

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

[Note: legal to draft amendment language and security to review KMS requirements. Marissa, loop Solutions Architect for the deployment runbook.]

From: Tim Ross <tim.ross@magellananalytics.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carla Fernandez <carla.fernandez@magellananalytics.com>, procurement@magellananalytics.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 10:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request: Exec approval — Magellan Analytics special terms (data residency & audit scope)

Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We appreciate Redwood's flexibility. A few clarifications from our side after internal review with Procurement and the CISO: 

- Discount: acceptable if applied to the first 12 months; we prefer 22% but can live with 20% if that facilitates a faster signature.
- Audit frequency: our CISO still requests two on-site audits in the first year given the nature of the data processed (financial analytics). If you can reduce to one on-site but allow a third-party to conduct up to one additional remote assessment, we may accept.
- Third-party auditors: we need the ability to bring an independent assessor; we can work with your approved list or propose an auditor but will need redaction and dispute processes clarified.
- KMS: our security team requires either customer-managed keys (preferred) or a detailed KMS integration plan.

Attached is our procurement checklist (Magellan_Audit_Request_Form.docx). We are targeting signature by 23 Apr to make our quarter. Can you confirm final text by EOD 21 Apr?

Best,
Tim Ross
Head of Procurement, Magellan Analytics
+44 20 7946 0200

[Attachment: Magellan_Audit_Request_Form.docx]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Ross <tim.ross@magellananalytics.com>, procurement@magellananalytics.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exec approval — Magellan Analytics special terms (data residency & audit scope)

Tim — thanks. Confirming Redwood's final position so Legal can produce a short amendment (we will attach to the main MSA):

1) Commercial: 20% discount for the first 12 months only (documented as a one-time concession).
2) Audit: one on-site audit permitted in any 12-month period (first year) with 45 days' advance notice. Additionally, we will allow one remote assessment by a third-party auditor. Third-party auditors must either be from Redwood's approved list or sign our standard auditor NDA; any proposed exceptions require Legal review.
3) Data residency: Redwood will maintain logical EU residency for customer data and support customer-managed KMS for EU keys. Maintenance exceptions will be limited and require 7 days' notice except for emergencies where we'll provide post-event notification.
4) Deployment: dedicated on-prem gateway allowed but must be customer-managed. Customer must provide COI and asset ownership confirmation in the SOW. Redwood liability limited per the SOW and indemnity clauses.

Next steps: Legal (Karthik) to prepare the amendment and updated SOW today; Security (Rishi) to validate the KMS integration checklist; Solutions (Marissa) to draft deployment runbook. Procurement (Magellan) to issue PO after amendment.

If Magellan agrees, we will circulate the amendment for signature. Tim — can you confirm acceptance of these guardrails by EOD 22 Apr so we can keep your timeline?

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
